name: opencode-browser-flow-plugin
description: browser flow — opencode plugin: visible Chromium over raw CDP + always-visible overlay (select/resize) + flow watcher that records to a tmp folder and returns a chat-ready transcript. Chrome fallback via full puppeteer.

scripts.build:extension: rm -rf extension/dist && mkdir -p extension/dist && bun build extension/sidepanel.tsx --outdir extension/dist --target browser --format esm && cp extension/dist/sidepanel.js extension/sidepanel.js && cp extension/dist/sidepanel.css extension/sidepanel.css
scripts.build:all: bun run build && bun run build:extension
